content.text: {"intent":"insight","restated_question":"Which devices in initech-003 show sustained RAM pressure across the 30-day telemetry window? 'Consistently constrained' means the device is flagged by the ram_pressure detector, using the memory-utilisation threshold and duration defined in policy, not a single high reading.","assumptions":["'Consistently constrained by RAM' maps to the ram_pressure detector, which looks at memory % over the 30-day window rather than only the latest snapshot.","The policy thresholds for ram_pressure define what counts as constrained, so the answer should cite them.","The admin asked for identification only, so no remediation or upgrade actions will be proposed."],"steps":[{"tool":"run_insights","purpose":"Run the ram_pressure detector to find devices with sustained high memory utilisation over the 30-day window."},{"tool":"get_policy","purpose":"Retrieve the ram_pressure threshold and duration so the answer can state the definition used."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
